units.source_text: 我按照常规引领他们参观了金阁。

en.t: As usual, I led them on a tour of the Golden Pavilion.

units.source_text: 泥醉的美国兵摇晃了一下，把鞋脱了下来，东一只西一只地扔在地上。

en.t: The dead-drunk American soldier swayed, took off his shoes, and tossed them onto the ground, one here and one there.

units.source_text: 我用冻僵了的手从兜里掏出一份需要在这种场合朗读的英文说明书来。

en.t: With my frozen hands, I pulled from my pocket an English guide text that had to be read aloud on such occasions.

units.source_text: 可美国兵从旁边伸手把它抢了过去，怪声地读了起来。

en.t: But the American soldier reached over from the side, snatched it away, and began reading it in a strange voice.

units.source_text: 我的导游就成为不必要了。

en.t: My services as a guide were no longer needed.
